outlook.summary: Not financial advice — this is a personal tracking dashboard meant to organize publicly available information for research purposes. Always size positions and confirm with your own research.

strongest.area: Cybersecurity, led by CrowdStrike and Zscaler
strongest.reason: both extended their post-earnings rallies into this week, with CrowdStrike unveiling a wave of new Falcon platform integrations at its Fal.Con conference and Zscaler climbing ahead of its September 3 earnings report

the 'AI isn't eating software' narrative keeps gaining traction after last week's strong earnings from Microsoft, Salesforce, and ServiceNow, with some strategists arguing the sector's rally could run through October

weakest.area: AI chip and infrastructure names, led by Nvidia, AMD, and TSMC
weakest.reason: all three pulled back sharply on profit-taking after last week's blowout Nvidia earnings, with rising Treasury yields and the overnight U.S.-Iran escalation adding to the risk-off tone

weakest.area: Crypto, with Bitcoin and Ethereum both retreating
weakest.reason: higher rate expectations following Fed Chair Warsh's hawkish inflation comments pressured risk assets broadly, pulling Bitcoin back from Friday's highs near $81,000

outlook.nextStep: The overnight U.S.-Iran escalation near the Strait of Hormuz is the biggest new risk factor and is probably better watched than acted on until there's more clarity on whether it stays contained. The divergence between the still-rallying enterprise software trade and the profit-taking-driven pullback in AI chip names is worth a closer look for signs of where capital rotates next.

signals.title: U.S. and Iran exchange strikes near the Strait of Hormuz, first clash in a month
signals.body: U.S. Central Command confirmed strikes on Iranian rocket launchers on Aug 30, with Iran responding by launching missiles at a U.S. base in Jordan; reports indicate almost all of the Iranian missiles were intercepted. The news pressured stock futures and pushed oil higher on a reopened Strait of Hormuz risk premium, even as the broader ceasefire framework from earlier this year formally remains in place.
signals.focus: a genuine escalation risk worth watching closely for further headlines before drawing conclusions either way

signals.title: Fed Chair Warsh's hawkish inflation tone pushes the 10-year yield to 4.73%
signals.body: Warsh's comments that inflation has not meaningfully slowed lifted Treasury yields further this week and raised the odds of a September 16 rate hike, adding pressure to rate-sensitive growth stocks and crypto alike.
signals.focus: probably better watched than acted on until the rate picture gets more clarity from upcoming data

signals.title: AI chip stocks trade choppily as investors balance strong demand against rate concerns
signals.body: Micron, Nvidia, Broadcom, and Intel all saw volatile trading Monday as the market weighs continued strong AI infrastructure demand (including Nvidia's new $3.5B MediaTek investment) against the drag from rising yields and the overnight Iran-driven risk-off tone.
signals.focus: worth a closer look at whether this is simple profit-taking after last week's earnings-driven rally or the start of a deeper pullback

signals.title: Cybersecurity and enterprise software extend their post-earnings rally
signals.body: CrowdStrike unveiled a wave of new integrations (Falcon on Google Cloud, Falcon IQ, expanded Project QuiltWorks) at its Fal.Con conference, while Zscaler and peers climbed ahead of upcoming earnings reports. Coverage of the sector has noted the 'AI isn't eating software' rally could run through October.
signals.focus: worth watching whether this rally has legs beyond the initial earnings-driven relief, especially into Zscaler's September 3 report

signals.title: Bitcoin and Ethereum pull back as rate-hike odds rise
signals.body: Both cryptocurrencies retreated from Friday's highs (Bitcoin from near $81,000) as the Fed's hawkish tone pushed up expectations for a September rate move, weighing on risk assets broadly.
signals.focus: worth watching whether this proves a shallow pullback within the recent range or a deeper reset in rate-sensitive risk assets

signals.title: Amazon deepens its Nvidia GPU partnership as AWS demand accelerates
signals.body: AWS and Nvidia announced an expanded deal for 2 million additional GPUs by 2028, and Evercore ISI raised its Amazon price target to $355 citing strong retail signals, even as the broader AI-infrastructure trade cooled Monday.
signals.focus: worth a closer look as a sign of continued hyperscaler capex commitment even amid the pullback in chip stocks

signals.title: Robotics names stay mixed as the broader capex story holds
signals.body: Tesla eased back with the broader market Monday even as its robotaxi rollout continues to expand, while Teradyne held near recent highs after last month's strong earnings beat and raised guidance.
signals.focus: worth treating single-day swings as noise relative to the longer-term capital-flow trend into robotics and automation
